notes: Access: plain HTTP (requests/curl_cffi, chrome120 impersonation) got DataDome 403 on every anthropologie.com HTML page (robots.txt and *_sitemap.xml URLs worked fine, 200s). Headless Playwright (stealth args) also hit a DataDome CAPTCHA challenge page. Checked robots.txt first - no Claude-specific full-site Disallow, so used Claude-in-Chrome (real browser session) as the tier-3 last resort, which rendered pages normally. Investigation for Bestsellers, scoped to the anthrohome (Home & Furniture) storefront only: (1) fetched anthrohome/categories_sitemap.xml (453 URLs) and grepped for best/popular/top/trend/favorit - the only 'top' matches were 12 'collection-top-rated-*' pages (e.g. collection-home-top-rated, 3515 products) and one collection-lacquer-trend-shop (a styling/trend editorial shop, not a bestseller listing). (2) Opened collection-home-top-rated: H1/breadcrumb/title are all 'Top Rated', badges on individual items say 'Top Rated', and it is a customer-review-rating-driven bucket (~half the whole catalog, 3515 products) - a materially different concept from sales-based Bestsellers. Its body marketing copy does say 'Shop bestselling pieces... customer favorites' but that is passing marketing language layered on a ratings mechanism, not the page's own taxonomy - excluded per brief section on 'collections that merely mention bestselling products in passing'. (3) Site search on the Home storefront for 'best sellers' returned a literal 3-item search-results page (one product literally named 'Apotheke Best Sellers Petite Scented Candle Trio', a rug, and a book) - a search-results page, not a merchandising PLP, and far too small/incidental to be a real Bestsellers listing. (4) Checked the full 'New!' mega-nav (This Week, Furniture, Art & Mirrors, Bath, Bedding, Candles, Decor & Pillows, Kitchen & Dining, Lighting, Outdoor, Rugs, New Gifts, Seasonal Decor) and the Sale sub-nav - none use Bestsellers/Best Sellers/Top Sellers/Popular/Trending/Customer Favorites naming. Every PLP does expose 'Bestselling' as a SORT option only (not a standalone listing/URL). No dedicated Bestsellers, Top Sellers, Popular Products, Most Popular, Customer Favorites, or Trending Products PLP exists anywhere in the anthrohome navigation, sitemap, or site search. Conclusion: no genuine Bestsellers PLP on this site's Home vertical.
